Bot: Trick or treat!
#Policeman.Face.angry
Policeman: W-what is it?! An extortion?! At our precinct! 
You: We are just asking for candy sir, it’s Halloween.
#Policeman.Face.annoyed
Policeman: Ugh…{{wi}} Aren’t you guys too old for that? Also, I’m pretty sure you chose to come up to me because I’m… {{wi}}plump. {{wi}}Isn’t that fatphobic? I should arrest you!
#Policeman.Face.normal
Policeman: Whatever, your costumes are nice.
